thread:
mariya-cs: Quick async check-in for LuminaHealth renewal — they hit a webhook surge overnight. Symptoms: webhook 500s, retries creating duplicate events, and embeddings usage spiked triggering billing alerts. Renewal call next week so we need a short-term mitigation + a fix for idempotency. Details below.

incidents-bot: Alert: webhook-endpoint-prod returned 5xx (120 events) in the last 60m — delivery error rate increased.

devon-platform: On it. Can you paste a sample request_id and a log snippet? Also which embedding model/config are they using? I'll check the delivery queue and rate limiter.

mariya-cs: Sample request + event IDs below. Request id: req_2026-03-17-84a1. They use `text-embed-1-small` via hosted API, batch size ~64. CS says billing alert from billing@lumina and AE is escalated.

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-1-small","input":["..."],"request_id":"req_2026-03-17-84a1"}'
```

mariya-cs: Event ids: evt_aa12, evt_bb34, evt_cc56 — duplicates observed in their system.

ashley-eng: I'll take the idempotency/retry changes. Quick clarifying q: are retries originating from our delivery worker or the client? If ours, we should dedupe by `event_id` and add a short-lived store. I'll open a PR to add a guard and backoff. :+1:

sam-oncall: Temporary mitigation I can apply now: set webhook backoff to 30s and throttle embeddings batch size for org `lumina_42` from 64 -> 16. I can push an org-rate override. Command: `rbctl org-rateset lumina_42 --embeddings 16`

mariya-cs: Please throttle now, thanks — I'm on a sync with their AE in 30m and need to show progress. Applying throttle and backoff will reduce duplicate retries.

devon-platform: Looking at the delivery logs: worker `deliver-7` OOM'd and restarted, causing inflight items to requeue. That produced duplicates. Short-term patch: make delivery idempotent by writing `event_id` keys to Redis with TTL=24h before ack. Will help dedupe on restarts.

ashley-eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingress/pull/472 — adds dedupe via Redis and exponential backoff for upstream 5xx. Adding unit + integration tests.

mariya-cs: Linking ENG ticket ENG-3245 to the PR. Can you give an ETA? Renewals team needs a quick summary for the renewal call later this week.

ashley-eng: ETA ~3-5h to merge + deploy to staging, 6-8h to prod if staging looks clean.

sam-oncall: I'll watch the staging deploy and keep logs streaming to #incidents, and add a temporary metric for duplicate events (`ingress.duplicates.count`).

mariya-cs: Perfect. Next steps: (1) Sam applies throttle/30s backoff and monitors, (2) Ashley lands PR + deploys to staging, (3) Devon applies Redis dedupe for workers and verifies queue health. I'll update the customer and add notes to the renewal doc (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3245). Thanks team <3
